content: Agent Skills ecosystem (mid-2026): SKILL.md = folder + YAML frontmatter + markdown instructions + optional bundled scripts/resources; ~40 products support the open standard (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Goose, OpenCode, Databricks, Snowflake); marketplace landscape grew from 1 to 8+ registries in 2 quarters (Anthropic's anthropics/skills official repo, Agensi curated paid marketplace, Cursor Directory, ClaudeSkills.wiki, awesome-lists, OpenCode registry). Skilldex (arXiv 2604.16911) is directly comparable prior art: OSS package manager + registry for skill packages with format-conformance scoring, skillset bundling, 3-tier scope (global/shared/project), MCP server, metadata-only community registry.
